decision.rationale: The live OpenAI response path now validates hierarchical planner and reject-only verifier payloads against their own versioned contracts before returning them to the autonomy runtime.

finding.evidence: Added explicit post-response validation branches and two transport-level regression tests covering valid hierarchical and verifier payloads.
finding.title: Live A/B/C provider responses were validated as legacy tutor answers

limitations: This result closes a software-contract defect; it does not establish provider availability or architecture quality.
